models.label: Flint Local
models.note: Run locally through Ollama on an Apple M4 Max with 128 GB memory (Flint 39.8B, int4 quantisation). Patched after generation; the model emits no reasoning tokens, so no effort setting applies. Repairs: one missing closing parenthesis that aborted the whole script; 27 constructor calls that passed materials as geometry parameters, producing NaN geometry; a helper call with a segment count in the material slot; a dwellings loop reading properties createDwelling does not return; a water shader using a time uniform it never declared; and a renderer that was never attached to the canvas element the page declares, so the finished scene existed only in an orphaned buffer. As generated, the page showed nothing at all.

models.label: Qwen 3.5 35B Local
models.note: Run locally through Ollama on an Apple M4 Max with 128 GB memory (Qwen 3.5 35B, Q4_K_M quantisation). Patched after generation; the model thinks natively (about 1,000 reasoning tokens) and takes no effort setting. Repairs: two unused imports of unmapped or nonexistent addon modules; undefined variables and light-name typos; a missing dot in lightAmpel.intensity; fog used before creation; a dead call to a hallucinated curve.getUAt method; an uninitialised branches array; vertex colours passed as a raw array instead of a BufferAttribute; a missing geometry guard in a scene.traverse callback; the DOM canvas pushed into scene.children; canopy basePos and idHash never set; no initial camera position or orbit target, which left the camera inside a tree; and a duplicated loader element that stayed on top of the page forever. As generated, the page showed nothing at all.
